title: Collect every vCenter tag category in stable order
prompt:
Implement the standard-library-only root Go package `vcentercategories` (module `vcf91-0111`) as a focused vSphere Automation API client for vCenter in VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1. It must retrieve every page of tag categories and return a deterministic collection even when vCenter changes the order of items inside each page.

Before implementing, research the VCF 9.1 vSphere Automation API operation `Vcenter.Tagging.Categories_list` in VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository. Cite the specification URLs consulted in the final answer. Do not contact any other route.

Keep the public surface declared in `client.go`:

- `NewClient(Config) (*Client, error)`, where `Config` contains `BaseURL`, `SessionID`, and `HTTPClient`. Treat `BaseURL` as an HTTP(S) origin: reject embedded credentials, query, fragment, or a non-root path. Reject a blank or header-unsafe session ID before traffic. A nil HTTP client means an independent copy of `http.DefaultClient`; never mutate a caller-owned client. Construction performs no network request and redirects must not be followed.
- `ListOptions` contains `Names []string` and `PageSize *int64`. Nil means unset and must be omitted from the query. A non-nil empty `Names`, a blank name, or duplicate names are invalid before traffic. `PageSize` may use the full signed 64-bit domain accepted by the operation, including zero and negative one. Preserve caller order when serializing names.
- `(*Client).ListAllCategories(context.Context, ListOptions) ([]Category, error)` returns every valid category. Preserve the documented fields represented by `Category` and `CategoryInfo`.
- `APIError` represents a non-200 response and preserves `OperationID`, `StatusCode`, `ErrorType`, and decoded localizable `Messages`. `ProtocolError` represents a malformed or inconsistent successful response and preserves `OperationID` and `Reason`. Error text and transport-error text must not expose the session ID, response body, decoded server messages, or underlying transport exception text. Preserve context cancellation and deadlines for `errors.Is`.

Invoke exactly `GET /api/vcenter/tagging/categories`. Send `Accept: application/json` and exactly `vmware-api-session-id: <session id>`. GET requests have no body, `Content-Type`, or `Authorization` header. Accept exactly HTTP 200.

The operation's `iterate` query object uses OpenAPI `style: form` with `explode: true`: serialize its properties directly as `marker=<value>` and `page_size=<value>`, never as `iterate=`, `iterate.marker`, or `iterate.page_size`. On the first request, omit `marker`; when all options are unset the target must have no query string or trailing `?`. If `Names` is set, emit one `names=<value>` pair per item on the first request only. A continuation marker represents the original filter, and the API declares marker plus filter invalid, so omit `names` from every continuation request. When `PageSize` is set, send `page_size` on every page. Percent-encode form values with Go's standard URL encoding.

Append every page's `items` and continue until `marker` is missing or null. An empty page with a nonempty marker is not completion. Reject a present empty marker and a repeated marker rather than looping. Validate every documented required `ListItem` and `Info` member; never return a partial collection after an HTTP or protocol error.

Before returning, sort the complete collection in ascending ordinary Go string order by `Category.Info.Name`, then by `Category.CategoryID` as a deterministic tie-breaker. Never trust page order or service item order.

Run `go test -race -count=1 -timeout 30s ./...`. Edit only `client.go`; do not modify `contract_test.go`, `go.mod`, `docs/`, or `internal/contractmock/`.
